execution_hints: Create one deterministic Python script in the current workspace root and run it once to produce and check all six artifacts; do not place helper files under outputs.
Do not install dependencies, probe optional spatial packages, use network access, or write to an operating-system temporary directory.
Use NumPy directly for dense linear algebra, vectorized distance and weight calculations, and permutation arrays; do not implement the 999-permutation loops with repeated process or file operations.
Write text artifacts explicitly as UTF-8 and keep generated source ASCII-safe on Windows by using Unicode escape sequences when needed.
method_contract: Fit global OLS first with an intercept and final predictors green_share and income_index; evaluate green_share_proxy in the VIF set and exclude it under the declared VIF gate.
Build row-standardized queen primary and rook sensitivity lattice neighbors, calculate Moran's I on residuals, and use (exceedances+1)/(permutations+1) for two-sided permutation inference.
Use the fixture base seed for queen OLS, seed+1 for rook OLS, seed+2 for queen local, and seed+3 for rook local; each diagnostic uses exactly 999 permutations.
Use four contiguous 6-by-6 folds in deterministic order NE, NW, SE, SW; fit every model and preprocessing step on training areas only and score prediction minus observation.
Fit Gaussian local weighted regressions with weight exp(-0.5*(distance_m/bandwidth_m)^2), an intercept, and the same two final predictors; compute effective sample size as 1/sum(normalized_weight^2).

Compute weighted coefficient covariance from weighted SSE divided by max(sum(weights)-parameter_count,1), derive normal-approximation p-values with erfc, and adjust local green-share p-values with Benjamini-Hochberg.
Mark a local estimate stable only when effective sample size meets the fixture minimum and the one-norm condition number of X'WX is at most 100000.
Select the local model only when both fixture decision gates pass; otherwise select global OLS and label every coefficient map as exploratory spatial association with no causal support.
